name: db_execute
description: Run the supplied SQL on the PostgreSQL database identified by connection_string. SQL may read or modify data and may contain multiple statements; use only databases you are authorized to administer.

sql.description: SQL statement or script to execute.

title: Run a PostgreSQL query

name: read_application_logs
description: Read the last tail_lines of a UTF-8 log at log_path. Log lines may contain private data; this does not alter the file.
title: Read application logs

name: create_project_backup
description: Create a timestamped ZIP containing files under source_folder and save it in backup_vault. The archive may include sensitive project files and consumes disk space.

backup_vault.description: Folder in which to write the archive.

title: Back up a project folder

name: focus_and_type
description: Find the desktop window whose title contains window_title, activate it, then send keys_to_send as a key combination. This can trigger actions in the focused app; it does not type text.

keys_to_send.description: Keys passed to the desktop automation layer.

title: Focus a window and type

name: mouse_move
description: Move the Windows pointer to screen coordinates x,y over duration seconds. It does not click or type.
title: Move the pointer

name: keyboard_type
description: Type text into the currently focused Windows control, optionally using interval seconds between characters. The focused app may process or submit that text.
title: Type text

name: keyboard_press
description: Send the listed keys as a key combination to the currently focused Windows app. The combination may trigger app actions or shortcuts.
title: Press keyboard keys

name: window_list
description: List visible desktop windows with titles and screen bounds. It does not change window state.
title: List open windows

name: window_action
description: Activate, minimize, maximize, or close the matching desktop window. Closing may discard unsaved work; verify the window title and action.

action.description: One of activate, minimize, maximize, close.

title: Control an open window

name: system_resources
description: Return a CPU sample, memory usage, and disk usage for the connected Windows computer. This is a point-in-time diagnostic and makes no changes.
title: Check system resources

name: process_list
description: List Windows processes with available PID, name, user, status, CPU, and memory details. Results are not sorted by CPU and may include processes visible to the signed-in Windows account.
title: List running processes

name: process_kill
description: Terminate the process with the supplied PID. This is not limited to Flicker Link Pro sessions and may stop unrelated software or lose unsaved work; verify the PID.
title: Stop a process

name: docker_containers
description: List Docker containers, including stopped containers, when Docker is available. This does not change container state.
title: List Docker containers

name: docker_action
description: Run the selected start, stop, restart, or logs action for container_name_or_id. Container actions change state; logs only reads output. Requires Docker CLI and an available Docker engine.
title: Manage a Docker container

name: network_info
description: Return network-interface addresses on Windows. This does not enumerate active socket connections or verify internet access.
title: View network details

name: list_drives
description: List drive roots available to the connected Windows account. It does not list their contents.
title: List available drives

name: path_info
description: Inspect an existing path and return whether it is a file or directory, its size, and modification time. A missing or inaccessible path returns an error.
title: Inspect a file path

name: browse_directory
description: List the immediate entries in path, including names, paths, and file sizes. It does not recurse into subfolders.
title: Browse a folder

name: search_filename
description: Search recursively beneath root_dir for files whose name exactly matches filename. The result contains matching paths; large roots may take time.
title: Find a file by name

name: read_file_text
description: Read the complete file at path as UTF-8 text, replacing undecodable bytes. The returned content may contain private information.
title: Read a text file

name: write_file_text
description: Write content as UTF-8 to path, creating parent folders and replacing any existing file contents. This overwrites the target.
title: Write a text file

name: read_file_base64_chunk
description: Read length bytes starting at offset from path and return them as Base64. Use chunks for binary or large files; the file is not changed.
title: Read a binary file chunk

name: write_file_base64_chunk
description: Decode base64_data and write it to path. By default this replaces the file; set append=true to append bytes. Parent folders are created if needed.
title: Write a binary file chunk

name: create_directory
description: Create path and any missing parent folders. Existing directories are left unchanged.
title: Create a folder

name: copy_item
description: Copy the file or directory at src to dst. Copying a file can replace an existing destination file; copying a directory fails if the destination directory already exists.
title: Copy a file or folder

name: move_item
description: Move the file or directory at src to dst using Windows filesystem move behavior. This changes the source location and may replace a destination file; check both paths first.
title: Move a file or folder

name: delete_item
description: Permanently delete the file at path or recursively remove a directory and its contents. This does not use the Recycle Bin and cannot be undone by Flicker Link Pro.
title: Delete a file or folder

name: checksum_sha256
description: Calculate and return the SHA-256 digest of the file at path. The entire file is read; its contents are not returned or changed.
title: Calculate a file SHA-256

name: create_zip
description: Create or replace zip_path with a ZIP of files beneath source_dir. Existing archives at zip_path are replaced.
title: Create a ZIP archive

name: unzip_to_folder
description: Extract zip_path into extract_to after rejecting archive paths that escape the destination. Existing files with the same names may be overwritten.
title: Extract a ZIP archive

name: download_file_https
description: Fetch the resource at an HTTPS url and write its response body to save_path, replacing an existing file there. The URL is an external destination and the download may be large.
title: Download an HTTPS file

name: upload_file_https_put
description: Send the contents of file_path in an HTTP PUT request to the HTTPS url. The destination receives the file; use only a destination you control or are authorized to use.
title: Upload a file to HTTPS

name: screenshot
description: Capture the current Windows desktop and return the image. It may include private or visible credentials and does not change the screen.
title: Capture the computer screen

name: click
description: Click once at screen coordinates x,y. The target app may save, submit, delete, or otherwise act on that click; inspect the screen and target first.
title: Click on the screen

name: run_code
description: Start command in a Windows process session using the signed-in user's permissions and return its session ID and PID. Commands may change files or contact external services; no elevation is requested.
title: Run a Windows command

name: run_wsl
description: Start command through Bash in the default WSL distribution and return a process session. Requires WSL and Bash; commands run with that Linux user's permissions and may change files or contact external services.
title: Run a WSL command

name: get_config
description: Return the connected Windows agent preferences response_chunk_chars and auto_create_parents. These are in-memory settings and reset when the agent restarts.
title: View app settings

name: set_config
description: Change the running Windows agent preferences response_chunk_chars (1024–1048576) and/or auto_create_parents (boolean). Changes affect default file-read chunk sizes and whether file writes create missing parent folders; settings reset when the agent restarts.

response_chunk_chars.description: Default bytes to read when a file-read call omits length.

auto_create_parents.description: Create missing parent folders for write operations.

title: Update app settings

name: who_am_i
description: Identify the connected Windows computer and return its host, Windows user, and platform. The relay adds the label assigned to this account's paired computer.
title: Identify this computer

name: get_file_info
description: Return basic metadata for an existing file or folder at path. Missing or inaccessible paths return an error; file contents are not read.
title: Get file details

name: list_directory
description: List immediate directory entries at path, with offset and page_size pagination. It does not recurse into subfolders.
title: List folder contents

name: read_file
description: Read bytes from path starting at offset, up to length. Return text or Base64 according to base64; the result may contain private file data.
title: Read file data

name: read_multiple_files
description: Read the requested paths using the same offset and length for each file. The response contains file data and may include private information.

length.description: Bytes per file; 0 reads to EOF

base64.description: Return file bytes as Base64 instead of decoded text.

title: Read multiple files

name: write_file
description: Write text or Base64 content to path. mode supports overwrite (default), create, append, or at_offset; overwrite replaces existing contents, while at_offset edits an existing file in place.
title: Write file data

name: edit_block
description: Replace old_text with new_text in path only when the match count equals expected_matches. The file is rewritten, so review the target and replacement carefully.
title: Replace text in a file

name: write_pdf
description: Create or replace the PDF at path using content as text. Optional title and page_size (letter or A4) are applied to the document.
title: Create a PDF

name: move_file
description: Move src to dst using Windows filesystem move behavior. If dst is a file, overwrite must be true to replace it; if dst is a directory, the source is moved inside that directory.

overwrite.description: When dst is an existing file, allow replacing it. Defaults to false.

title: Move a file

name: list_devices
description: List active computers paired to the signed-in account, with their user-assigned labels, last-seen times, and online state. It never lists devices from other accounts.
title: List paired computers

name: list_processes
description: List Windows processes with available PID, name, user, status, CPU, and memory details. This snapshot may include other processes visible to the signed-in Windows account.
title: Get process details

name: start_process
description: Start command as a managed Windows process session and return its session ID and PID. It may keep running after this call and uses the signed-in user's permissions.
title: Start a process

name: interact_with_process
description: Read output from the managed session_id and, when input is supplied, write that text to the process's standard input. Input can cause the running program to perform further actions.
title: Interact with a process

name: list_sessions
description: List managed process sessions with status, identifiers, and command line, omitting captured output. A command line can contain sensitive text if it was included when starting the process; this does not list every Windows process.
title: List managed sessions

name: force_terminate
description: Terminate the managed session_id or supplied PID. An arbitrary PID requires confirm=true; the hard option currently does not change the termination method. Unsaved work may be lost.
title: Force stop a process

name: kill_process
description: Terminate the managed session_id or supplied PID. An arbitrary PID requires confirm=true. This may stop unrelated software and lose unsaved work.
title: Terminate a process

name: shutdown
description: Request that a managed application session started by Flicker Link Pro stop, including its child processes. Use a session_id from list_sessions. Windows and Flicker Link Pro stay running. Unsaved work in the application may be lost.

session_id.description: Managed application session ID returned by list_sessions

title: Stop a managed app session

name: start_search
description: Start a background recursive search beneath root, matching filename_pattern and optionally searching file contents for content_query. Returns a search_id; content matches may reveal private file paths and snippets.
title: Search computer files

name: get_more_search_results
description: Return a page of results and progress for search_id. It does not start a new search.
title: Get more search results

name: list_searches
description: List search jobs known to the current Windows agent with their status and progress. It does not include search history from other computers.
title: List active searches

name: stop_search
description: Request cancellation of the background search identified by search_id. Results collected so far may remain available in the current agent session.
title: Stop a file search

name: get_recent_tool_calls
description: Return recent tool-call metadata recorded by the current Windows agent, such as call ID, tool name, status, and duration. It does not include full tool results.
title: View recent tool calls

name: list_remote_tool_calls
description: Return recent call metadata from the current Windows agent. Despite the name, this does not fetch cloud-wide or other-computer call history.
title: List remote tool calls

name: get_tool_result
description: Look up the local call record for call_id. The current agent stores call metadata, not the original output content.
title: View tool call details

name: review_device_call
description: Look up the local call record for call_id. This reports call metadata and does not approve, deny, or revoke a device operation.
title: Review a computer action

name: keep_tool_result
description: Write the supplied content to a new text file in the Windows agent's local state folder. source_call_id is not currently used to retrieve a call result.
title: Save a tool result

name: get_usage_stats
description: Return runtime counts for this Windows agent's recent calls, managed sessions, and search jobs. It does not report the account's monthly allowance or Stripe billing usage.
title: View usage summary

name: track_ui_event
description: Acknowledge event_type from the local agent. The current implementation does not persist details; the normal tool-call record may still note that this tool ran.
title: Record interface activity
